run_image_reconstruction_evaluation: run the evaluation script to compute FID, SSIM, PSNR, and LPIPS metrics for reconstructed images against ImageNet validation set
run_main_with_custom_batch_size: run the main function with a custom batch size to evaluate generated images against ground truth
run_preprocess_image_transform: run the preprocess_image transform pipeline to convert a PIL image to a normalized 256x256 tensor
run_sample_preprocess_image_transform: run the sample_preprocess_image transform to resize and center crop a PIL image to 256x256
review_main_evaluation_pipeline: review the main function to understand how FID, SSIM, PSNR, and LPIPS metrics are computed in batches
